quote.text:
Sheriff Dar Leaf dumped 2,100+ pages of dominion confidential internals in 2024.

Serbian nationals in Dominion's Belgrade office were remotely accessing U.S. tabulators and servers while votes were still being counted. 

Leaf's affidavit is clear: Dominion directed them to do it. The emails admit they couldn't run proper background checks because Serbian law blocked it.

Then the Chinese kill switch.

Internal document DOM_DC01459733: A Dominion voting tablet shipped through Shanghai, China customs.

Chinese engineers had direct server access to the firmware for American machines. The guy running software development for all of it? Djordje Matijevic, sitting in the Belgrade office.

Leaf's 2025 release spelled it out: Chinese nationals (HP ties) modified the firmware. They tested it offshore in Serbia to dodge U.S. certification.

Components got mislabeled to fake compliance. Belgrade wasn't just a dev shop it was a CCP proxy hub in Europe.

This is the exact pipeline I've been exposing:

Venezuela (Smartmatic built the remote control model under Maduro) → exported into Dominion → Serbia as the cutout for live remote access → China owning the firmware backdoor.

No American fingerprints. Just foreign proxies, vetting blackouts, and offshore tweaks.

They leaked the docs, sanctioned the attorney who got them, and screamed "conspiracy." Same playbook every time.

Paper ballots. Same-day voting. Ban foreign supply chains. Or keep trusting machines run by this cartel.

The receipts are in their own emails.

I'm just some fucking guy but the entire intelligence apparatus couldn't expose this?

O'Keefe won't even touch it.
https://x.com/i/status/1951129928868503665
